Sam (partnerships): FYI ACMEcloud EU-Gov listing ask just landed. They want a packaged evidence bundle: SOC2 extract, firmware pen-test (third-party), SI attestation, OEM HSM letter, and a short artifact manifest. Listing window is May 12; they asked for artifacts by Apr 25. Can we confirm owners & a quick runbook?
Toni (security): I'll take point on the pen-test redaction and vuln triage. Need to confirm scope: do they want full supply-chain or just our delivered firmware image?
Sam (partnerships): ACME's intake notes say "firmware image + bootloader + supply chain summary preferred" but will accept redacted supply-chain notes. They flagged HSM usage & key-management as high interest.
Elena (SI): SI attestation requires an OEM letter confirming HSM module FIPS/CC status and key custody flow. I can draft attestation text but need OEM sign-off.
Raj (eng-infra): Ops checklist: artifacts must be in eu-west-1, presigned links TTL <= 7 days, and reviewers need one-click SSO to bucket. I can create a presign workflow and a policy template. Example (CLI):
```
aws s3 cp firmware-v2.bin s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/edge/v2/ --region eu-west-1 && 
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/edge/v2/firmware-v2.bin --expires-in 604800
```
Mira (compliance): SOC2 report is current; I'll extract scope pages and prepare a statement of tested controls. Also adding a short evidence manifest CSV with fields: artifact_name, artifact_type, s3_path, presign_expiry, redaction_status.
Toni (security): Redaction plan: redact PII and any customer-specific IP, remove raw vuln PoCs, and include a remediation attestation for fixed findings. We'll use the standard redaction template and note methodology (CREST/OWASP/SANS).
Anya (legal): Heads-up: ACME requires a non-disclosure for access to unredacted artifacts and prefers a one-way redaction + attestation model. I'll prepare a limited NDA or MSA amendment for evidence viewing — can we avoid sending full unredacted unless absolutely necessary?
Sam (partnerships): Good call. Partner asked for a "witness option" for the pen-test (live session). Is that something we can support?
Toni (security): We can offer a live witness session but need to schedule during vendor's test window. Also we should run a 1-day internal pre-check of the firmware and bootloader to catch basic issues before handing to pen vendor. I can allocate a red-team slot next Tue.
Elena (SI): SI attestation timeline: OEM to confirm HSM letter by Apr 21, then SI can finalize attestation same day. Who's contacting OEM?
Sam (partnerships): I'll DM the OEM POC now (edge-oem-ops@vendor.example).
Raj (eng-infra): Additional ops items: set S3 bucket lifecycle so artifacts expire after 90 days (auto-delete), enable server-side encryption with CMK, and attach `acme-eu-gov` tag to all objects. I'll push Terraform snippet to the repo.
Mira (compliance): Also include a data classification page (Public/Internal/Restricted) and a retention statement. ACME flagged retention rules for EU-Gov listings.
Anya (legal): For press/joint announcement: ACME requires a 48-hour embargo after listing for joint comms. We should coordinate marketing once listing is approved.
Sam (partnerships): Action items (owners & targets):
- Toni: internal pre-check + vendor plan review + redaction checklist (due Apr 18)
- Mira: SOC2 extract + evidence manifest CSV + data classification (due Apr 20)
- Raj: presign workflow, bucket policy, Terraform snippet (due Apr 22)
- Elena: SI attestation draft + OEM outreach (due Apr 21)
- Anya: NDA/limited-access doc for reviewers (due Apr 19)
I'll collect artifacts in `s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/eu-gov/edge/`. Please prefix filenames with `acme_eu_` and include a small README.md in the folder listing the artifact manifest.
DeployBot: Reminder: All uploads with potential PII must follow evidence-upload policy. Use secure vault for unredacted files. https://redwood.internal/docs/evidence-upload
Toni (security): I'll post the redaction checklist and severity threshold table after I review the vendor test plan. :white_check_mark:
Raj (eng-infra): Quick note: presign links will be https-only and will require `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header on upload. I'll document sample curl for reviewers if they need direct GET.
Elena (SI): If OEM delays HSM letter, SI attestation can include a conditional statement indicating pending OEM signature; partner accepted that in past cases but prefer signed whenever possible.
Sam (partnerships): Partner timeline reminder — Apr 25 for artifact submission to meet the May 12 go-live. I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Apr 16 to check progress.
Mira (compliance): I'll version the SOC extract with a hash and add it to the manifest so reviewers can verify integrity.
Anya (legal): Sending draft NDA now to this thread DM list. Keep discussion of any unredacted artifacts in the NDA channel.
Sam (partnerships): Thanks team. We'll keep the thread updated as artifacts land. Please tag updates with `#evidence-ready` once files are uploaded.
